findings.issue: The seeded default has no TDD anchor. Tech-spec Agent Verification Plan, row for task 6, requires `make test` to show 'refresh: <N>s at 1/60/300s AND the seeded default before any z'. Task 06's own Acceptance Criteria carries it ('Before any `z` press the header shows the seeded default (`refresh: 1s`), not `refresh: 0s`') and What to do step 2 implements it in `app.setup()` — but none of the five anchors touch `app.setup()`, and `top/top_test.go` appears in neither Context Files nor Details/Files. The seed is therefore verified only on the stand (task 08 step 4), one wave later, which is not what the tech-spec's verify column promises. `Test_renderSysstat_refreshFormat` passes an explicit duration and proves nothing about the seed.
findings.fix: Add a sixth anchor: `top/top_test.go::Test_app_setup` — after `app.setup()` returns, `app.config.refresh == defaultRefresh`. Add `top/top_test.go` to Context Files and to Details/Files. `Test_app_setup` already exists (top/top_test.go:18) and already opens a test PG connection, so no new environment dependency is introduced. No wave-3 conflict: task 07 touches only dialog.go/dialog_test.go, so top_test.go is free. Note in Post-completion that this file is an addition to the tech-spec's declared file set for task 6.

findings.issue: The task states 'Живой PostgreSQL не нужен: ни один unit-тест фичи его не требует' and, in Description, that 'Фаза 1 скилла pre-deploy-qa (Environment Rebuild) сводится к `make build`'. Both are wrong for this task's own first acceptance criterion. `make test` runs `go test ./...`, and `top/top_test.go` (`Test_newApp`, `Test_app_setup`) calls `postgres.NewTestConnect()` → PG 17 on port 21917 (internal/postgres/testing.go:11-30). Without the `lesovsky/pgcenter-testing:0.0.11` container (deployment.md:33-38, architecture.md:154-157, .github/workflows/default.yml:9) `make test` cannot go green. The QA gate would then report a connection failure as a feature FAIL or a blocker — a false negative produced by the gate's own stated prerequisites. The task already lists deployment.md in Context Files, which documents the container, so the file contradicts itself.
findings.fix: Rewrite Environment Rebuild as: start the `lesovsky/pgcenter-testing:0.0.11` container (PG 14-19 on ports 21914-21919), then `make build`. Replace the Dependencies bullet with: 'The feature's own new tests need no live PostgreSQL, but the existing suite does — `make test` will not run at all without the test container. A connection failure is an environment problem, not a feature FAIL.'

findings.issue: Wrong call-site count. Step 7 says 'Update the five test call sites of `renderSysstat`' and Details repeats 'five literal `renderSysstat(` call sites', then enumerates them as one in Test_renderSysstat_compact + one in the verboseSysstatLines helper + two in Test_renderSysstat_compactUnchanged — which is four, and four is what `top/stat_test.go` actually contains (lines 59, 150, 284, 285). The tech-spec's '5 for renderSysstat including tests' is correct because it counts the production call inside `printSysstat`; the task dropped that one and kept the number.
findings.fix: State: four test call sites in `top/stat_test.go` plus the single production call inside `printSysstat` (`top/stat.go`), five in total — which is what the tech-spec's Backward Compatibility section counts.

findings.section: What to do / Details → Edge cases
findings.issue: Two design decisions are delegated to the implementing agent rather than pinned. Step 5 says to 'выбрать поведение' for degenerate geometry (`g.Size()` returning zeros after a return from pager/editor/psql) and record the choice in the decisions log; the Edge cases block does the same for a terminal narrower than `minDialogInputWidth`. Neither case has a decision in the tech-spec, and neither has a TDD anchor — while `Test_dialogInputX0AlwaysLeftOfX1` is scoped to 'the input domain declared in the function comment', a domain defined by the very guard that has not been decided. The property test's coverage is therefore not determined until after the implementer has chosen.
findings.fix: Pin both behaviours in the task. Recommended, matching the existing style of the view-name guards at dialog.go:51-74: on `maxX <= 0 || maxY <= 0`, or on a terminal too narrow for `minDialogInputWidth` usable columns, print a message to the cmdline and return nil without calling SetView. Then add an anchor — e.g. `top/dialog_test.go::Test_dialogGeometryGuard` — and state the resulting input domain explicitly in the property test's description instead of deferring it to a comment that does not exist yet. If the choice must stay open, escalate it to the tech-spec before wave 3 starts rather than settling it inside an unreviewable free choice.

findings.issue: The 'a test can exist and still check the wrong thing — read the body' list names four criteria (the `n/a` width invariant, `x0 < x1` in dialogInputX0, the two-token case in composeCmdline, deterministic ordering in filterToken) but omits tech-spec Acceptance Criterion 8 / Decision 13: a column name carrying escape sequences must not leave the terminal in a changed state through the indicator. That is the feature's only security-relevant assertion, and `dev-security-auditor` is deliberately absent from every reviewer set in this feature, so this QA gate is the last thing standing between a nominally-present sanitisation test and none. The blanket 'все критерии tech-spec обойдены поимённо' covers it only by name.
findings.fix: Add the sanitisation criterion to the read-the-body list: confirm filterToken's control-rune test actually feeds a name containing `\033[31m` and asserts both that the runes are gone and that the rune count used by the truncation ladder is unaffected.

findings.issue: Link targets are repo-root-relative and do not resolve from the task file's own directory: `[top/config.go](top/config.go)` resolves to `docs/features/015-feat-tui-papercuts/top/config.go`, and the same applies to every feature-artifact and project-knowledge link. Tasks 01, 03, 05, 07 and 08 in this feature use `../../../`-prefixed paths that do resolve. The split is batch-wide (02 and 04 share the defect with 06), so fixing it here should be done together with them.

findings.issue: The Reviewers section lists the two reviewers without the note explaining that `dev-security-auditor` is omitted deliberately.
